box64.note: Pinned Box64 source contains a wrapper entry for vkCreateAndroidSurfaceKHR, so the x86_64-to-ARM64 Vulkan call path is structurally represented. This is not runtime evidence.

androidTransport.note: This proves only Android-process transport. It cannot satisfy the guest/Wine transport gate.

guestGraphicsTransport.note: A transferable graphics resource must cross from the Android host into the actual guest/Wine execution side and remain importable/synchronizable without trusting raw process-local pointers.

capabilityDiscovery.note: Extension discovery is diagnostic only and never proves that PocketPC can create a surface, swapchain or visible Present path.

rejectedRoutes.route: send ANativeWindow pointer over Display Bridge socket
rejectedRoutes.reason: ANativeWindow is process-local opaque state; a pointer value is not a transferable cross-process handle.

rejectedRoutes.route: treat GDI window_surface.flush as DXVK Present
rejectedRoutes.reason: Wine Vulkan uses the graphics driver's pVulkanInit/WSI contract; GDI framebuffer flush does not establish a Vulkan surface or swapchain.

rejectedRoutes.route: reuse wineandroid.drv as the DXVK WSI backend
rejectedRoutes.reason: Pinned Wine 11 wineandroid.drv exposes pOpenGLInit but no pVulkanInit.

rejectedRoutes.route: promote Android-to-Android AHardwareBuffer transport to guest graphics readiness
rejectedRoutes.reason: Distinct Android processes prove host handle transfer only. Box64/Wine receive, Vulkan import and synchronization remain separate guest gates.

rejectedRoutes.route: advertise VK_KHR_win32_surface before a real PocketPC surface backend exists
rejectedRoutes.reason: Extension promotion without a process-valid surface implementation would make DXVK progress into a guaranteed invalid presentation path.

targetArchitecture.phase1: Android host proves AHardwareBuffer allocation plus same-process AF_UNIX handle round-trip.
targetArchitecture.phase2: A dedicated Android :gpu_probe process receives the real transferable AHardwareBuffer handle, validates descriptor and bytes, and returns evidence from a distinct PID.
targetArchitecture.phase3: Probe the physical Android Vulkan driver and record surface, swapchain, AHardwareBuffer external-memory and synchronization capabilities without promoting readiness.
targetArchitecture.phase4: Expose the exact Wine Vulkan driver v47 ABI through pVulkanInit while surface creation remains explicitly fail-closed.
targetArchitecture.phase5: Guest-side transport receives a real transferable graphics-buffer identity and imports it without trusting raw pointers.
targetArchitecture.phase6: Prove guest/host synchronization ownership for the imported graphics resource.
targetArchitecture.phase7: Implement Wine Vulkan surface creation, presentation support and extension mapping on the proven transport backend.
targetArchitecture.phase8: Implement acquire/render/present ownership and swapchain presentation.
targetArchitecture.phase9: Run D3D11 Present smoke and require a host-visible frame before recording evidence.
targetArchitecture.phase10: Only then unblock controlled Roblox/DXVK application attempts.
